def source_env() -> None:

            if line.startswith("export "):
                line = line[7:].lstrip()
            key, _, val = line.partition("=")
            key = key.strip()
            val = val.strip()
            if not key:
                continue

            lexer = shlex.shlex(val, posix=True)

            lexer.commenters = "#"
            parsed = "".join(list(lexer)).strip()
